column4: Even though the Class A-2-B Notes are floating-rate notes, the issuing entity will not enter into any interest rate hedges to mitigate the interest rate risk. An increase in SOFR (or any alternative benchmark rate adopted by the sponsor) will increase the amount due as interest payments on the Floating Rate Notes without any corresponding increase in the interest due on the automobile loan contracts which may cause you to experience delays or reductions in the payments on your notes.
